about: WP32 inputs to implementation/review-ledger.json that git history cannot supply: files read in full and left unchanged, explicitly reviewed working-tree changes bound to their SHA-256 bytes and oracles, and the environment lanes as recorded in docs/implementation/validation.md. Regenerate the ledger with `npm run review:ledger`; `review-closure` checks it. Historical lane entries do not certify later working-tree changes. DR29: withdrawn stale byte-bound review claims for src/runtime/personal-settings.ts, src/entry/personal-host.ts, src/entry/oma-mac.ts. Hashes were not silently refreshed; these edited owners require fresh review. Historical readUnchanged entries apply only to unchanged committed files; changed files are NOT_REVIEWED.

reviewedChanges.note: Read in full: sync and async effects retain exact primary/cleanup outcomes, including thrown null/undefined; cleanup runs once after the effect settles and is awaited. Outcome-matrix and nested corruption/publication-knowledge assertions pass; five source-copy controls assertion-killed. This helper assembles ownership returns, not error classification, process-death proof or publication retry policy.

Read in full: only observed contention returns null; failed acquisition preserves primary beside close failure, contended close is not repeated, close revokes descriptor access before the fallible return. Two source-copy controls assertion-killed. Existing inode identity/fence rules retained; native Darwin flock and inherited descendant death are not proved by controlled composition.

Read in full: held parent/pin returns preserve original failure; if pin/root return prevents transfer, the opened result is locally returned once, retaining both failures. Untransferred-result leak control assertion-killed. openat2 containment has no fallback and is not weakened. closeEvery still reports the first close failure after attempting all returns; this review does not claim all caller finally paths are closed.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 P0-8 residual round, re-binding the earlier host-owner review: publishHostStaged now flushes the renamed staged tree's regular files and every directory that names them, then the destination's parent and the staging root the name came from -- the same structural durability the Linux publish's fsyncTree keeps, so the index never names file contents a crash could lose. HostTemporary ownership, the owned-boundary repair, the one-shot stray collection at the publish slot, listHostStaged and removeHostStaged are unchanged; native Mac execution of the flush is NOT_RUN on this Linux host.

Read in full: input ownership starts before output acquisition, nested cleanup returns output then input despite failure; failed sealer construction retains discard failure. Two source-copy controls assertion-killed after correcting the constructor oracle's TypeError (initial INVALID not counted). Existing archive bytes/AES-GCM/chunk authentication unchanged; real Keychain, native Mac execution and all stream-sink lifetime boundaries remain separate.

Read in full: partial snapshot ownership spans clone/publication and discard; primary plus discard and cleanup-only outcomes are not success. Discard-removal control assertion-killed. Actual local-fixture snapshot regressions pass. Running-snapshot maintenance/control/society cleanup and clone/thaw failure composition remain open; no native VM, APFS or power-cut proof. P0-8: the snapshot prune removes each staged name through removeHostStaged's owner-bits repair, not a blind rmSync.

Read in full: settings/adoption writer returns and nested engine-file/parent returns preserve primary failure. Parent-leak control assertion-killed; controlled adoption fails on directory observation before opening any credential file. Bundled-only engine resolution, separate engine home and one retry owner retained. No actual auth.json was read; all pre-transfer absence and native credential adoption boundaries are not certified. P0-8/DR32: preparePiInteractive repairs a mode-000 .engine/themes tail through ensureOwnedUserDirectory before the locked replace, which is lockedOwnedReplace -- engine files are oma's, not a generic user path.

Read in full: an acquired reader's close/read failure is not absence; bounded UTF-8/identity/single-name checks retained. Darwin immutable publication returns its writer and temporary while preserving primary beside cleanup and flushes existing destination on retry. Post-open ENOENT-to-absence control assertion-killed. Linux contained resolution retained; native Darwin crash durability and pre-transfer pin-close absence composition are not certified. P0-8: ensureOwnedUserDirectory(path, ownedFrom, faults?) is the owned-tail entry point; the faults seam passes the Linux durability observer through unchanged.

Read in full: serialized per-item writer uses a cross-process lock and awaits the fenced writer before returning it; abort and identity are rechecked before write. Controlled in-memory store failure beside lock close and cleanup-only failure retain exact outcomes. Native Swift helper, real Keychain and credential execution were not exercised. P0-8: the per-item lock's directory is ensured through ensureOwnedUserDirectory inside its own boundary, not trusted as-is.

Read in full at the 2026-10-01 host-only package checkpoint: platform-aware runtime metadata preparation completes before spawn; explicit engine/store/arguments/environment/fence, error retained until actual direct-child close, and signal/null/nonzero close not success. Fourteen controlled tests pass; eleven source-copy controls assertion-killed under complete TAP with no cancellations/skips or harness errors, including the direct exit-only oracle. Actual Mac entry/bundled package manager and installed Personal PTY pass on Linux. Actual close does not establish arbitrary descendant/cgroup death; fallible listener acquisition and native Mac execution remain open. No credential files or real provider used. P0-8: the engine directory and package store are ensured through ensureOwnedUserDirectory inside dirname(stateRoot).

Read in full: one scoped native ESM generation owner, complete selected-path replacement before generation advance, relative/late imports retain their parent's generation, unrelated engine modules unchanged, hook deregistration on close. Seven actual bundled-loader/native-cache tests pass. Generation identity is not a byte snapshot or a bound on accumulated engine/module memory. Native Mac and hook registration/deregistration failure injection are not proved.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 P0-8 residual round, re-binding the 2026-10-01 host-only package review: writePackageIndex's resource listing treats the filesystem's own ENOENT as the only absent answer -- EACCES, EIO and every other unfinished observation refuse the write for realpath and for the lstat of the name realpath just answered, so an index is never committed without what the package still holds. One value-aware grammar produces the immutable explicit Mac-only local decision, refuses duplicate/value-like/project combinations and Linux use; index byte bound, inside-containment, symlink real-path pinning, role reconciliation and per-source entries are unchanged.

Read in full: child owns snapshot creation, engine walker group, EOF cancellation and cleanup; parent bounds output and duration. Caller-death and uncooperative walker tests; EOF and group-cleanup mutants assertion-killed. Does not claim cleanup after the owner itself is SIGKILLed or an OS crash.

Read in full: frame-bounded base64 chunks bind exact receipt JSON identity and extent; collection rejects changed digest, oversize, gaps and incomplete replies. Real broker/ledger restart test retains one effect and isolates actors; dispatcher supplies the authenticated actor, never a wire actor.

Read in full: frame-bounded status response includes a lexicographic continuation, refuses an individually oversized row, and does not claim a cross-page snapshot. This is response pagination, not database keyset pagination.

Read in full: bounded-buffer regular-file hashing retains pre/post identity and observed-size checks; large executable asset, spawn tamper and stale-generation tests pass; document-cap, spawn-digest and commit-digest mutants killed. Does not eliminate same-UID replacement after the read.

Read in full: canonical project/Society/basename/header identity, exact shape and round trip; traversal, added cwd, malformed references and replaced identity are rejected by DR29 guest-history tests. Pure value codec; no writer or native proof.

Read in full: canonical Personal birth/basename/header identity, typed exact query and bounded metadata page validation. DR29 reference/traversal, pagination and strict successful-exit oracles pass. A reference locates facts and does not grant execution.

Read in full: one private duplex socket owns correlated observations, per-query monotonic timer/cancellation, late replies and one flushed final handoff. Real local socket plus actual Linux PTY holder and cancellation/partial/loss tests pass. Native Mac and systemd holder launch NOT_RUN.

Read in full: existing saved Personal birth/header/cwd admission and real SDK metadata, no registry and no guest-supplied paths. Real history replacement/corruption, paginated count/preview and actual controlled holder oracles pass. Remote text search is preview-only; no native Mac execution claim.

Read in full: existing project binding and Society birth/header/private cwd admission, lexical bounded pagination, SDK-skipped files remain unknown. Real saved files and scripted launcher/current listening holder conflict oracles pass. Actual manager launch NOT_RUN.

Read in full: bundle-owned one-shot helper argv/stdin, bounded output and actual-exit plus strict reply validation. Controlled helper tests pass; Foundation bookmark implementation is NOT_BUILT/NOT_RUN on this Linux host.

Read in full: host-record binding/bookmark/Git identity precedes already-running project settings observation; absent binding is empty, ambiguity/unknown is refusal. Real Git relocation/replacement and controlled settings tests pass. Bound first seed requires an already running app/guest, and native Mac NOT_RUN.

Read in full: composition callback consumes frozen exact candidate/check profile, cgroup resources, private raw checkout and confined argv/environment; controlled command/manager-outcome oracles pass. Actual systemd/cgroup probe remains independently denied and NOT_RUN; builder tests do not certify kernel enforcement.

Read in full: export() normalizes the request intent before the ledger digests it -- absent `since` and explicit `since: undefined` are one request, and neither is a JSON value the canonical encoder can name. The intent keeps every other field; validation of society/canonical/head is unchanged. MAC-240 oracles: the legacy-spelled digest is a different request that fails closed (never replayed nor re-run), and §6.4/MAC-420 export passes end-to-end under the new digest.

Read in full: the prepared rootfs gains RESIDENT_PATHS.workerArchive so the confined engine's worker-only review archive mount target exists before any bind; the directory list otherwise unchanged, order and ensureDirectory semantics retained. SCN-R01 exercises the Worker review archive end-to-end through the confined path; SCN-C10 exercises package extension loading under the same rootfs.

Read in full: resolvedBindSource names each socket bind source by the real directory it reaches instead of a /proc/<pid>/fd anchor bubblewrap cannot traverse inside its user namespace; only the parent resolves, the leaf need not exist, and a missing parent keeps the lexical spelling (ENOENT/ENOTDIR only -- other resolution failures propagate). R28 asserts the pure recipe with fabricated dirs; SCN-C08 runs a real confined shell under the filter; DR27 private-argument tests hold the recipe's value preservation.

Read in full: the oma tip rewrite addresses the last command-tip cell by position (replaceColumn) instead of matching the command's text, because upstream truncates a name when an extension added a command; the cell's original SGR color is carried and the tip is width-bounded like swapText. Open TUI PTY oracles hold the branded header, tips and terminal restoration for all eight endings including reload-update with an extra registered command.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 P0-8 residual round: commitManagedGeneration now repairs `.oma-config`/`generations` through ensureOwnedDurableDirectory before the confirmation flush and every read the edit makes -- a degraded owned ancestor wedges the repair's refusal, never a silent absent observation. `ownedFrom` is the caller-named oma-owned ancestor (the data root for a `.projects` bundle), `.oma-config` itself for a user's `--config`; a stray at the boundary slot still refuses and is never unlinked, while a mode-000 owned component at or below the boundary is repaired. Generation identity, publish order, rollback record before the commit point, unconfirmed blocking and the quiescent collection are unchanged.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 P0-8 residual round: the staged publish fsyncs the arrived tree or file, `dest`, every intermediate scoped directory the name descended through (a `local/a/b/c` name flushes `local/a` as well as `local/a/b`), `local`, and the staging root's parent -- closing the gap where a crash kept a scope directory without the child that walks to the staged copy. Strict-prefix strays are still collected once through held descriptors, a non-regular staged leaf refused, dead copies removed whole; the Mac path delegates to publishHostStaged, now the same structural flush.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 P0-8 residual round: the managed-commit wrappers thread a caller-named `ownedFrom` through commitRoleSet/projectBundle/deriveSessionSettings/writeSettings/commitManagedEdit/commitField into commitManagedGeneration; a caller that cannot vouch for an oma-owned ancestor omits it and `.oma-config` remains the boundary, so the user's `--config` ancestors are never repaired. Role-revision input, the unchanged short-circuit, inline-edit and field-descriptor paths are unchanged.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 P0-8 residual round: toggleExtension accepts the caller's `ownedFrom` and forwards it to the managed generation commit; the editable gate, the missing-file repair mode, the core-extension lock and the per-role entry rewrite (order preserved, exact declaration removed) are unchanged.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 tenth-residual round: the settings ensure's first existsSync can answer 'absent' only because a degraded oma-owned ancestor hid the file, so after ensureOwnedUserDirectory repairs `.projects/<project>` the path is observed again and the seed/write branch runs only when it is still absent -- a bundle that was only hidden is read back, never seeded over (fail-before: committed quota 4 was replaced by the seed's 5). The seed candidates' probe is lstatSync(throwIfNoEntry): ENOENT alone is absent, an unobservable candidate refuses rather than defaults (the society root's own owner repairs it, a --config path is the Human's). applyPackageChange's per-project skip got the same treatment: the owned repair runs before the probe for every non-current project, a failed repair is reported to the Human like a failed edit, and only a post-repair 'absent' skips. Package-activation reconciliation and the role-set seed are unchanged.

Read in full at the 2026-10-05 P0-8 residual round: deriveSessionSettings names the data root as the commit's repair boundary only when the session's configuration lives beneath it (no `--config`), and project settings field saves and extension toggles commit with the data-root boundary; a Human-placed `--config` bundle keeps `.oma-config` the boundary, so the user's ancestors are never repaired. Project binding, tenure, the rederive-on-save path and the settings surface are unchanged.
